title: Receipt-gate fetch-depth repair (worker-protocol-gates.yml)

judgments.rationale: The receipt-gate CI job now fetches full history, so check_pr_receipt.py's git cat-file -e validation works on real PR head SHAs. Direct users: every lane worker whose PR body cites head SHAs under ## Evidence - previously a CORRECT head SHA always failed the gate. Internal-to-the-team, not end-user facing.

Before: correct head SHAs always failed the gate (false-negative 100% on the affected case, proved by the mechanism tests). After: the gate validates correctly. No in-repo receipt with real before/after CI numbers; delta rests on the miniature proof, so above the middle but not higher.

Every claim checkable: 140-line test file at ref with 5 tests, workflow diff visible at ref, and the grader re-ran the 5 tests herself against the merge tree (5/5 pass, worktree left clean). Mechanism proved on a faithful miniature of the real CI failure, not on the live CI job itself - hence not a 10.

A committed regression-guard test pins fetch-depth: 0 in the workflow file itself. fetch-depth: 0 semantics in actions/checkout@v4 are stable; the guard fails loudly if anyone reverts it. Residual risk: a future actions/checkout default change or gate-script rewrite could obsolete the comment/test.

Purely additive at the merge (7 workflow lines + new test file; the branch's deletions of kernel/value_calculus.py and test_intent_disqualification.py were resolved away and both files still exist at the tip). Consistent with sibling jobs that already fetch full history. No new breakage; merge --stat clean.

evidence_ledger.detail: command evidence rests on the grader's word
evidence_ledger.citation: python3 -m pytest tests/test_receipt_gate_checkout_depth.py (5 passed in 0.57s, run 2026-10-12 by the grader against the merge tree)
